_convergence_criteria.description: HARDENED gate (hardened_gate_enabled=true). Converged iff, on the SETTLED post-reconciliation registry critical/structural series: (A) gamma_critical >= 0.30 AND (B) sustained over 2 consecutive settled recomputes AND leave-one-round-out robust within 0.05, AND (C) 3 consecutive settled rounds with zero novel critical findings. Sparsity fallback: if cumulative critical < 8 the slope is unreliable so closure rests on (C) alone and gamma_critical is reported-not-gated. All-severity gamma is logged as a diagnostic only and NEVER gates. This is the conjunction, not the legacy OR.
